**Finding: Compliant (preferred level).**

- **§ 12.3** affirmatively negates any restraint on our business: we may develop, acquire, licence, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and conduct business in any field or territory, and Vendor acknowledges no exclusivity or non-compete commitment.
- **§ 2.1** supports this with no minimum quantity or purchase commitment.
- **§ 12.4** is a restraint on *Vendor* (it may not develop a service competing with our analytics products) — a benefit to us, not flagged.
- **§ 13.4** contains only ordinary licence-use limits (reverse engineering, security bypass, unlawful use), which are not field-of-use or non-compete restrictions.

No redline proposed.
